idea-plugin.name: Insomniac
idea-plugin.description:
Prevents your system from sleeping while a long-running task is active in the IDE.

Too often I have started a full rebuild of a big project or an inspection run, went for coffee, and twenty minutes later when I came back: my laptop has gone into sleep mode and the task is only half finished. To prevent this from happening, I built this plugin. It keeps the system awake when it detects a task that has been active for more than one-and-a-half minute. Zero user interface, just set it and forget it.

On the Mac NSProcessInfo is used to prevent sleep. It is also possible to fall back to the built-into-the-OS tool Caffeinate, by unsettings the registry key `insomniac.mac.native.sleep.blocker` checkbox. On Windows the OS SetThreadExecutionState function is called. And on Linux the mouse is wiggled by one pixel (if you know of a better way, let me know or send a pull request).
